subject: English
passage: Modern wolves and large cats such as mountain lions typically maintain stable territorial boundaries throughout their adult lives, which had prompted some researchers to speculate that the extinct saber-toothed cat, a large predator, might have exhibited similar behavior. Saber-tooth teeth grew continuously, incorporating trace elements from prey, and so each dental layer reflects the ratio of nitrogen isotopes (15N/14N) in the local food web; thus, the sequence of layers shows where the animal hunted during life. Recent analysis of the nitrogen ratios in the layers of one saber-toothed cat canine in relation to the geographic distribution of nitrogen ratios in the environment shows the animal's territory began to shift dramatically as it aged, covering increasingly diverse hunting grounds in its final three years.
prompt: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined statement in the text as a whole?

choices.A: It discusses a characteristic shared by certain animals in order to explain why researchers raised a possibility that turned out not to be supported by data described later in the text.
choices.B: It illustrates a pattern of behavior among certain animals in order to present a theory about exceptions to that pattern that is weakened by a finding described later in the text.
choices.C: It describes a similarity in the behavior of certain animals in order to show why a method described later in the text did not reveal whether another animal also showed that behavior.
choices.D: It introduces a trait shared by certain animals in order to contextualize a hypothesis about the origin of that trait that is advanced later in the text.

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer because it most accurately describes how the underlined statement functions in the text as a whole. The underlined statement mentions a category of animals that have a feature in common: they typically maintain stable territorial boundaries throughout their adult lives. The text then presents the speculation of some researchers that the saber-toothed cat might also share this characteristic. However, an examination of the nitrogen isotope content in the layers of a saber-tooth canine indicated that contrary to the researchers' hypothesis, the cat had shifting territory that covered increasingly diverse hunting grounds in its final years. Thus, the underlined statement discusses a characteristic shared by certain animals in order to explain why researchers raised a possibility that turned out not to be supported by data described later in the text.

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect. Though the underlined statement presents a pattern of behavior (the habit of certain animals of maintaining stable territorial boundaries), the rest of the text does not present a theory of exceptions to that pattern; rather, the researchers are merely concerned with whether one particular animal has behavior consistent with the pattern.
